title: arctium × nothum subsp. debrayi
intro: Arctium × nothum subsp. debrayi, commonly known as a type of burdock, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as a diuretic, reduce inflammation, and aid in digestion. The bioactive constituents of Arctium × nothum subsp. debrayi include lignans, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are also believed to be beneficial in treating various conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues.
